from IPython.display import display, HTML

# Create HTML with embedded JavaScript for interactivity
html_content = """
<div id="datetime-selector">
    <div class="container-layout">
        <div class="form-container">
            <div class="date-row">
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label for="day">Day:</label>
                    <select id="day" class="form-control">
                        """ + ''.join([f'<option value="{i}">{i}</option>' for i in range(1, 32)]) + """
                    </select>
                </div>
                
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label for="month">Month:</label>
                    <select id="month" class="form-control">
                        """ + ''.join([f'<option value="{i}">{i}</option>' for i in range(1, 13)]) + """
                    </select>
                </div>
                
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label for="year">Year:</label>
                    <select id="year" class="form-control">
                        """ + ''.join([f'<option value="{i}">{i}</option>' for i in range(2020, 2030)]) + """
                    </select>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <div class="time-row">
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label for="hour">Hour:</label>
                    <select id="hour" class="form-control">
                        """ + ''.join([f'<option value="{i:02d}">{i:02d}</option>' for i in range(0, 24)]) + """
                    </select>
                </div>
                
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label for="minute">Minute:</label>
                    <select id="minute" class="form-control">
                        """ + ''.join([f'<option value="{i:02d}">{i:02d}</option>' for i in range(0, 60)]) + """
                    </select>
                </div>
            </div>
            
            <button id="generate-btn" class="btn btn-primary mt-3">Generate Assignment</button>
        </div>
        
        <div class="confirmation-container">
            <div id="output-message" class="mt-3"></div>
            <div id="confirmation-buttons" class="mt-3" style="display: none;">
                <button id="confirm-btn" class="btn btn-success">Confirm</button>
                <button id="cancel-btn" class="btn btn-danger">Cancel</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    
    <!-- Results section -->
    <div id="results-container" class="mt-3" style="display: none;">
        <h2>Your Cosmic Assignment Results</h2>
        <div id="planet-assignment" class="planet-result"></div>
        <div id="placement-results" class="placement-results"></div>
    </div>
</div>

<style>
#datetime-selector {
    width: 100%;
    margin: 20px 0;
}

/* Container layout for side-by-side display */
.container-layout {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    align-items: flex-start;
}

.form-container {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    margin-right: 30px;
}

.confirmation-container {
    flex: 0 0 300px;
    padding: 15px;
    border-left: 1px solid #ddd;
    min-height: 150px;
}

/* Style for date and time rows */
.date-row, .time-row {
    display: flex;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
}

/* Make the form groups display inline */
.form-group {
    margin-right: 15px;
}

.form-control {
    display: block;
    width: 200px;
    padding: 8px;
    font-size: 14px;
    height: 38px;
    border: 1px solid #ced4da;
    border-radius: 4px;
}

    padding: 8px 16px;
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 4px;

    margin-right: 10px;
}

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    // Get references to all elements
    const daySelect = document.getElementById('day');
    const monthSelect = document.getElementById('month');
    const yearSelect = document.getElementById('year');
    const hourSelect = document.getElementById('hour');
    const minuteSelect = document.getElementById('minute');
    const generateBtn = document.getElementById('generate-btn');
    const outputMessage = document.getElementById('output-message');
    const confirmationButtons = document.getElementById('confirmation-buttons');
    const confirmBtn = document.getElementById('confirm-btn');
    const cancelBtn = document.getElementById('cancel-btn');
    const resultsContainer = document.getElementById('results-container');
    const planetAssignment = document.getElementById('planet-assignment');
    const placementResults = document.getElementById('placement-results');
    
    // Store selected values
    let selectedValues = {};
    let currentStep = 'datetime'; // Possible values: 'datetime', 'name', 'complete'
    
    // Planets for random assignment
    const planets = [
        "Mercury", "Venus", "Mars", "Jupiter", "Saturn", 
        "Uranus", "Neptune", "Pluto", "Ceres", "Eris"
    ];
    
    // Placements/reasons for assignment
    const placements = [
        "Your cosmic energy aligns perfectly with this planet's vibrations",
        "The planetary position at your birth time creates a strong affinity",
        "Your numerological profile resonates with this celestial body",
        "Quantum astrological calculations indicate this is your cosmic home",
        "The celestial harmonics of your birth chart point directly here",
        "Interstellar alignments suggest a powerful connection between you",
        "Your chronological signature matches this planet's frequency",
        "Astral projections from your birth time converge at this location",
        "The metaphysical properties of your name link to this planet",
        "Cosmic wavelength analysis shows strong compatibility",
        "Gravitational pull calculations favor this assignment",
        "Your biorhythmic pattern mirrors this planet's orbit",
        "Stellar cartography indicates this as your spiritual center",
        "Astronomical algorithms highlight this cosmic connection",
        "Astrobiological factors show natural affinity to this environment"
    ];
    
    // Function to generate random results
    function generateRandomResults(name) {
        // Randomly select a planet
        const randomPlanet = planets[Math.floor(Math.random() * planets.length)];
        
        // Randomly select 5 unique placements
        let selectedPlacements = [];
        let remainingPlacements = [...placements]; // Create a copy to work with
        
        for (let i = 0; i < 5 && remainingPlacements.length > 0; i++) {
            const randomIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * remainingPlacements.length);
            selectedPlacements.push(remainingPlacements[randomIndex]);
            remainingPlacements.splice(randomIndex, 1); // Remove selected placement
        }
        
        // Create the results HTML
        planetAssignment.innerHTML = `<p>Based on your cosmic profile, ${name}, you have been assigned to: <span class="planet-name">${randomPlanet}</span></p>`;
        
        let placementsHTML = '<h3>Top 5 Reasons for This Assignment:</h3>';
        selectedPlacements.forEach((placement, index) => {
            placementsHTML += `<div class="placement-item">
                <span class="reason-number">${index + 1}.</span> ${placement}
            </div>`;
        });
        
        placementResults.innerHTML = placementsHTML;
        resultsContainer.style.display = 'block';
    }
    
    // Add click event for the generate button
    generateBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        // Store all selected values
        selectedValues = {
            day: daySelect.value,
            month: monthSelect.value,
            year: yearSelect.value,
            hour: hourSelect.value,
            minute: minuteSelect.value
        };
        
        // Display confirmation message
        outputMessage.innerHTML = `<h4>Confirm Your Selection</h4>
                                  <p>Date: ${selectedValues.day}/${selectedValues.month}/${selectedValues.year}<br>
                                  Time: ${selectedValues.hour}:${selectedValues.minute}</p>
                                  <p>Are you sure you want to proceed?</p>`;
        
        // Show confirmation buttons
        confirmationButtons.style.display = 'block';
    });
    
    // Add click event for confirm button
    confirmBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        outputMessage.innerHTML = `<h4>Confirmation Successful</h4>
                                  <p>Date: ${selectedValues.day}/${selectedValues.month}/${selectedValues.year}<br>
                                  Time: ${selectedValues.hour}:${selectedValues.minute}</p>
                                  <p>Please enter your name:</p>
                                  <div class="form-group">
                                    <input type="text" id="user-name" class="form-control" placeholder="Enter your name">
                                  </div>
                                  <button id="submit-name-btn" class="btn btn-primary mt-3">Submit</button>`;
        confirmationButtons.style.display = 'none';
        
        // Add event listener for the new submit button
        setTimeout(() => {
            const submitNameBtn = document.getElementById('submit-name-btn');
            const userNameInput = document.getElementById('user-name');
            
            submitNameBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
                const userName = userNameInput.value.trim();
                if (userName) {
                    // Store the name along with the date/time
                    selectedValues.name = userName;
                    
                    // Show final confirmation
                    outputMessage.innerHTML = `<h4>All Information Received</h4>
                                            <p>Name: ${selectedValues.name}</p>
                                            <p>Date: ${selectedValues.day}/${selectedValues.month}/${selectedValues.year}<br>
                                            Time: ${selectedValues.hour}:${selectedValues.minute}</p>
                                            <p>Your cosmic assignment is ready below!</p>`;
                                            
                    // Generate and display random results
                    generateRandomResults(userName);
                    
                } else {
                    // Show error if name is empty
                    userNameInput.style.borderColor = 'red';
                    const errorMsg = document.createElement('p');
                    errorMsg.className = 'error-text';
                    errorMsg.textContent = 'Please enter your name';
                    
                    // Insert error message after input if it doesn't exist
                    if (!userNameInput.nextElementSibling || !userNameInput.nextElementSibling.className !== 'error-text') {
                        userNameInput.parentNode.insertBefore(errorMsg, userNameInput.nextElementSibling);
                    }
                }
            });
        }, 100); // Small timeout to ensure the element is in the DOM
    });
    
    // Add click event for cancel button
    cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        outputMessage.innerHTML = '<h4>Cancelled</h4><p>Please adjust your selection if needed.</p>';
        confirmationButtons.style.display = 'none';
    });
});
</script>
"""

# Display the HTML
display(HTML(html_content))
